whenToUse: Quotes, invoices and orders with product/service rows, discounts and tax rates.
Exact per-rate totals with decimal-string money.
avoidWhen: Read-only small lists of numbers — use Table.
Generic repeatable form rows without money.
a11y: Each cell input is labelled by its column and row number.
Add/remove row buttons name the row; totals are announced on change.
